mapper.select: SELECT url_access_id, site_id, site_code, url_pattern, http_method, access_type, required_roles, required_auths, allowed_user_types, allowed_ips, require_csrf_yn, require_2fa_yn, priority, description FROM tb_role_url_access WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY priority ASC, (site_id IS NULL) ASC, CHAR_LENGTH(url_pattern) DESC, url_access_id ASC

#{roleId}
